text:
brian: Quick sync request — we need to align on the long-term routing + multi-region + tenant isolation roadmap. Customers keep asking for predictable latencies across geos and clearer launch criteria. Can we capture high-level priorities and a proposed rollout plan?

sana: +1. We should separate the short-term (next quarter) from long-term phases. Short-term: routing policies + basic affinity. Long-term: tenant isolation lanes, cross-region failover, policy DSL.

olivia: Suggest we define customer-facing guarantees per phase: e.g., Phase 1 SLA: 99.9% regional availability, Phase 2: cross-region RTO 30s for synced KV cache.

miguel: For rollout, infra needs clear gating signals: capacity commit, canary on 10% traffic, and perf regressions <=5% p50/p95. Otherwise we hold.

keiko: Ops perspective: include oncall playbook and evacuation steps for tenant quarantine. Also need automated telemetry for routing decisions.

brían: (typo) brian: meant to say: can we draft concrete launch criteria by EOW? I can shepherd with PM.

eva: Customer ask: enterprise customer requires routing that honors jurisdiction (data residency) + optional private dedicated pool. That impacts scoping for Phase 1.

sana: Proposal outline: Phase A (Q2): routing policy primitives (latency, cost, geo), per-tenant hints, affinity stickiness toggle. Phase B (Q3–Q4): tenant lanes + reserved capacity + basic quarantine. Phase C (next year): full policy DSL, cross-region active-active, hardened eviction semantics.

olivia: Acceptance criteria examples (short):
- policy primitives validated on perf harness
- canary across two regions with synthetic loads
- regression tests for KV cache correctness

miguel: Quick config example we prototyped for policy API:
```
policy: {
  strategy: "latency",
  allowed_regions: ["us-west1","europe-west1"],
  tenant_hint: {affinity: "regional", fallback: "global"}
}
```
This needs linting but shows intent.

keiko: Also add operational SLA checklist: runbook, alerting thresholds, rollback uncoupling, capacity throttles.

brian: Questions for product prioritization: which customer stories unlock revenue or landing deals? list top 3 asks.

eva: Top asks from sales: 1) data residency per region, 2) dedicated pool option (predictable throughput), 3) soft-eviction guarantees during overload.

sana: Tradeoffs: isolation lanes increase cost & fragmentation. Need model to estimate unit cost change per tenant band. Redwood Optimize can surface quantized estimates.

miguel: Implementation constraints: kernel selection + quantized runtime differences make some models incompatible across lanes. We need compatibility matrix as a gating artifact.

olivia: Can we set a small spike to produce the compatibility matrix + cost delta for common model families? 2-week spike.

brian: Approve spike. Sana, please own and deliver a one-pager with: roadmap phases, launch criteria, customer impact, and the compatibility matrix deadline in 2 weeks.

sana: Will do. I'll include proposed canary plan (10% traffic, 2 regions), telemetry events list, and acceptance test matrix.

ops-bot: Deploy notice: canary job queued for infra-spike at 09:00 UTC tomorrow — owner: sana.

keiko: One more ask: include a rollback SLI for routing regressions (error rate spike > 1% for 5m triggers auto-fallback).

brian: Good call. Add that to criteria. Thanks everyone — I’ll collate notes and share a draft doc by EOW. :thumbsup:
